change: Change only the wide FP16 full-y reduction scratch pitch between row batches. For each shape, set the row pitch to AlignUp(tileCount, 16) + 8 floats, preserving contiguous tile partials within a row while staggering consecutive row starts by 32 bytes modulo 64 bytes. Use the selected pitch in both UB budgeting and allocation. FP32/BF16 retain the original 16-float pitch.
hypothesis: The original 16-float row pitch places successive rows' reduction partials 64 bytes apart, so they begin at the same candidate bank phase. A shape-sized pitch ending at 8 modulo 16 floats alternates row starts by 32 bytes modulo 64 while retaining enough slots for every tile. The bank mapping and performance effect are unmeasured; no bank width is asserted.
